text: Code reviews are a vital part of software development. When a developer finishes writing new code, another team member carefully examines it before it is merged into the main project. This process helps catch bugs early, before they become bigger problems in the final product. Reviewing also encourages knowledge sharing: the reviewer learns about new parts of the system, while the original author receives helpful feedback and fresh perspectives. Over time, this habit improves the quality of the entire team, because everyone writes cleaner, more thoughtful code. Ultimately, code reviews build trust and create a stronger, more reliable software project.
